title: What to Do When Someone Dies in Zimbabwe: 5-Step Official Checklist
titleEn: What to Do When Someone Dies in Zimbabwe: 5-Step Official Checklist
cardSummary: Official 5-step bereavement checklist for Zimbabwe: medical death certification, civil death registration, funeral and repatriation permits, survivor benefits, and estate succession.
introHtml: Completing administrative, civil registration, probate, benefit, and tax clearance steps after a death in Zimbabwe centers on Civil Registry notifications under Chapter 5:02, estate reporting to the Master of the High Court, NSSA survivor and funeral grant claims, ZIMRA tax clearance, and consular document legalization. Because the Civil Registry (rg.gov.zw), Judicial Service Commission (jsc.org.zw), Foreign Affairs (zimfa.gov.zw), Health (mohcc.gov.zw under maintenance), and NSSA (nssa.org.zw) portals exhibit external errors, redirects, or TLS failures, this guide cites verified Veritas Zimbabwe legislation, ZimLII statutes, ZIMRA, Island Hospice and Healthcare, and HCCH status records.

steps.title: Medical Cause of Death and Civil Registry Notification
steps.html:
• Obtain a Medical Certificate of Cause of Death from the treating hospital or physician (or inquest/coroner paperwork where death occurred unexpectedly) [1][2].
  • Submit the notice of death to the District Registrar of the Civil Registry Department under the Births and Deaths Registration Act [Chapter 5:02] to collect a Burial Order and an official Death Certificate (noting prescribed statutory fee schedules) [1][2].

steps.title: Master of the High Court Estate Reporting and Probate
steps.html:
• Register the deceased estate promptly with the Master of the High Court in Harare, Bulawayo, or regional magistrates' centres under the Administration of Estates Act [Chapter 6:01] [3][4][5].
  • Lodge the Death Notice, preliminary asset inventory, and any original will executed under the Wills Act [Chapter 6:06] (paying prescribed Master's Office fees under SI 2023-034) so Letters of Administration can be issued to the executor testamentary or executor dative following the edict meeting [3][4][6][7].
  • Confirm minor beneficiary protections managed through the Guardian's Fund and apply customary estate rules under Part IIIA of Chapter 6:01 where relevant [3][5].

steps.title: NSSA Funeral Grant, Survivor Benefits, and Grief Support
steps.html:
• Submit claims for the NSSA Funeral Grant and Survivors' Pension or Grant under the National Social Security Authority Act [Chapter 17:04] and SI 2024-099 directly at regional branches of the National Social Security Authority (NSSA) [8].
  • Access bereavement counseling and family support services through Island Hospice and Healthcare in Harare (24-hour after-hours helpline +263 712 207 634) and Bulawayo [10][11].

steps.title: ZIMRA Tax Clearance, Estate Duty, and Asset Transfers
steps.html:
• Secure required clearances from the Zimbabwe Revenue Authority (ZIMRA) before filing final liquidation and distribution accounts with the Master of the High Court or registering deeds transfers [9].
  • Verify Estate Duty Act [Chapter 23:03] assessments (noting statutory thresholds and family-residence or vehicle exemptions where applicable) and Capital Gains Tax (CGT) rules: direct distribution of specified assets from an estate to lawful beneficiaries is ordinarily exempt from CGT, whereas executor sales to third parties attract CGT clearance [9].

steps.title: Cross-Border Consular Legalization (Non-Apostille)
steps.html:
• Zimbabwe is not a Contracting Party to the HCCH 1961 Hague Apostille Convention, so Apostille certificates are not used [12].
  • Have Zimbabwean Death Certificates and Letters of Administration authenticated through High Court/notarial channels and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, followed by embassy or consular legalization by the destination country [12].

contacts.name: Master of the High Court
contacts.note: Administers deceased estates, Letters of Administration, and Guardian's Fund under Chapter 6:01 (jsc.org.zw fails external TLS).

contacts.name: National Social Security Authority (NSSA)
contacts.note: Administers Funeral Grants and Survivors' Benefits under Chapter 17:04 and SI 2024-099 (nssa.org.zw redirects externally).

contacts.name: Zimbabwe Revenue Authority (ZIMRA)
contacts.note: Harare Head Office / Domestic Taxes; Estate Duty and Capital Gains Tax clearances for estates.

contacts.name: Island Hospice and Healthcare
contacts.note: 6 Natal Road, Belgravia, Harare (After-hours +263 712 207 634) and Bulawayo; bereavement support and counseling.
